content:
olivia: Heads-up — I need to change the retention policy for auth and admin-audit logs and wire up SIEM export to our new encrypted bucket. Questions below, want quick consensus before I open a PR.

olivia: Current ask: auth logs -> 1 year, admin-audit -> 3 years (compliance wants longer), pipeline -> ship to splunk for realtime, and archive to S3 encrypted with customer-managed KMS key `redwood-logs-prod`. Thoughts? :eyes: 

trevor: Do we have RBAC controls scoped so only sec/audit roles can read archived S3 objects? I think the infra S3 role still has read access today.

lina: Compliance: admin-audit 3y is minimum, prefer 5y for enterprise customers under DLP regs. For auth logs 1y is fine. Need proof of immutability for archived records (WORM) if we claim retention for regulatory reasons.

mike: Infra: we can enforce S3 bucket policies and SCPs so only KMS-granted principals can decrypt. But existing infra role (infra-ops) currently has kms:Decrypt on the old key; we must rotate policy to remove broad perms. Also need to ensure log-export lambda doesn't do `s3:PutObjectAcl` that could leak objects.

sam: From security side, add requirement that SIEM ingest uses sigv4 with STS temporary creds and we rotate the export IAM role every 90d. Also audit-bot should log every key usage event to a separate audit index.

jen: Legal: if we increase retention beyond 3y we need to update customer contracts and privacy notice. Start with default 1y/3y and make 5y opt-in for specific enterprise customers.

olivia: Good catch. For this change I propose: auth=1y, admin-audit=3y default; enterprise opt-ins can request 5y. SIEM stream to Splunk (realtime) + S3 archive encrypted with `alias/redwood-logs-prod` (CMK). RBAC: only `sec-read`, `audit-service` and `splunk-ingest-role` can decrypt.

mike: Implementation notes: 1) Create new CMK with key policy denying kms:Decrypt to infra-ops. 2) Update CloudTrail/S3 put events to require kms:Encrypt for that key. 3) Update terraform for `aws_s3_bucket` with `object_ownership = "BucketOwnerEnforced"` and `bucket_policy` deny non-allowed principals.

olivia: I can open a PR with the Terraform + policy snippets. Quick question on audit retention: do we want to set S3 object lock (Governance mode) for admin-audit? That would satisfy immutability concerns.

lina: Yes, S3 Object Lock Governance for admin-audit archives accepted. Need retention period stored in our compliance registry and auto-notifications before expiry.

sam: Also add a read-only SIEM role that only has access to the Splunk forwarder API, not to the underlying S3 archive. Prevent lateral access if SIEM creds are compromised.

olivia: Action items: 1) I open PR with TF changes (bucket + CMK + policies + object-lock) — assigned to @mike for review. 2) @sam draft the RBAC matrix for who can decrypt/read. 3) @lina update compliance registry and opt-in process. 4) @jen check contract language for >3y retention.

mike: Ack, will review PR and run a small canary to ensure Splunk ingestion handles encrypted object lifecycle.

audit-bot: New alert rule created: `kms-key-usage-alerts` -> posts to #incidents on anomalous Decrypt attempts.

olivia: Thanks all — if no objections I'll start the PR this afternoon and tag approvers. :thumbsup:

lina: No objections from compliance. Please include export proof-of-delivery logs for each archive action.

sam: No objections from security; prefer staged rollout: test org -> beta customers -> all.

olivia: Great, rolling plan noted. PR will include rollout windows and a teardown for rollback.
